issue_context.title: Add IServiceCollection extension for configuring CookiePolicy
issue_context.body:
CookiePolicy lacks an IServiceCollection extension for configuring CookiePolicyOptions. It's possible to do `services.Configure<CookiePolicyOptions>(options =>` but this has discoverability issues.

Proposal: Create an IServiceCollection extension `AddCookiePolicy(Action<CookiePolicyOptions>)`.
- Also, check the other middleware to see if they're also missing such an extension.

Current user code example:
https://github.com/Azure-Samples/active-directory-aspnetcore-webapp-openidconnect-v2/blob/f30a1709c777b909542cac9cac58808434ca82a7/1-WebApp-OIDC/1-1-MyOrg/Startup.cs#L27-L34
